verdict.rationale: Milvus's own docs name a Milvus Distributed deployment mode that runs on a massive-scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors, separate from the single-machine Standalone mode. Scale claims and a community comment citing horizontal scaling back this up. missing for 10: documentation of sharding/partitioning mechanics and cluster architecture, distributed deployment and operations guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-node scaling.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can scale beyond one node with sharding or distributed deployment

citations.quote: Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production
Milvus also supports Standalone mode for single machine deployment.
in 2023, it scaled up to tens of billions with consistent stability
